sections.heading: Testing and license services
sections.markdown:
## Testing and license services

FACT_ID: sec03-R01 | anchor: A01
The handbook's renewal-by-mail route covers eligible people temporarily away on active military duty and full-time out-of-state students, including spouses and dependents living with them. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=15]

FACT_ID: sec03-R02 | anchor: A01
An applicant who is physically incapacitated and cannot visit a DDS center may use the described remote service for an identification card only. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=15]

FACT_ID: sec03-R03 | anchor: A01
Mail renewal requires the application, eligibility evidence and any required payment. The handbook describes an 8-year term followed by an in-person renewal. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=15]

FACT_ID: sec03-R04 | anchor: A01
A license expired for at least 2 years cannot be renewed through the handbook's mail-renewal process. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=15]

FACT_ID: sec03-R05 | anchor: A01
The mail-renewal route does not allow name or address changes; those changes require an in-person DDS transaction under the described process. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=15]

FACT_ID: sec03-R06 | anchor: A01
The handbook states that a renewal completed by mail does not issue a REAL ID document. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=15]

FACT_ID: sec03-R07 | anchor: A01
Georgia does not issue driving or identification credentials whose document number is the Social Security number. At issuance or renewal, such an old number is replaced with a random document number. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=15]

FACT_ID: sec03-R08 | anchor: A01
After the document number changes, notify insurers or other organizations that use the old license or identification number for verification. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=15]

FACT_ID: sec03-R09 | anchor: A02
A lost or stolen credential may be replaced at a DDS center with proof of identity, or online through identity authentication when the online requirements are met. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=16]

FACT_ID: sec03-R10 | anchor: A02
The handbook's single-document replacement identity choices include a sealed certified birth record, naturalization or citizenship certificate, expired Georgia credential, valid United States passport or passport card, consular birth-abroad report, or expired Georgia interim credential. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=16]

FACT_ID: sec03-R11 | anchor: A03
For a noncitizen's replacement identity evidence, the handbook lists a valid foreign passport with valid arrival record, a valid permanent-resident card, or a qualifying employment-authorization document with evidence of a pending status-adjustment application. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=17]

FACT_ID: sec03-R12 | anchor: A03
The alternative replacement route requires 2 documents from the listed group: Social Security card, original or certified marriage record, prior-year tax return or wage statement, current insurance policy, current vehicle-registration receipt, voter card, military identification or orders, Georgia gun permit, transport-worker identification, or pay stub. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=17]

FACT_ID: sec03-R13 | anchor: A03
For the replacement alternative-document route, an insurance card does not substitute for the listed current insurance policy. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=17]

FACT_ID: sec03-R14 | anchor: A03
Changing the document number during replacement requires a police report showing theft, except when the existing number is the Social Security number. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=17]

FACT_ID: sec03-R15 | anchor: A02
Online DDS services include such functions as appointments, eligible renewals and replacements, address changes, record requests and license-status checks. Eligibility requirements, including the applicable REAL ID requirements, still apply. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=16]

FACT_ID: sec03-R16 | anchor: A03
Keep the DDS address record current; postal forwarding does not redirect DDS correspondence. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=17]

FACT_ID: sec03-R17 | anchor: A03
After moving, update the mailing or residential address within 60 days at a DDS center or through the online service. An in-person change needs evidence; an online change is checked through the postal service. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=17]

FACT_ID: sec03-R18 | anchor: A03
A legal name change requires an in-person DDS visit and a corrected license within 60 days. The handbook allows one no-charge replacement for the existing term. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=17]

FACT_ID: sec03-R19 | anchor: A03
For a name change, provide a certified acceptable marriage document or a court order. A Georgia marriage application is one of the listed document choices. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=17]

FACT_ID: sec03-R20 | anchor: A03
The handbook allows a hyphenated surname based on a Georgia marriage on or after November 1, 1982, when the certified marriage application records that surname choice. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=17]

FACT_ID: sec03-R21 | anchor: A03
The handbook offers driving histories covering 3 years, 7 years or the lifetime record. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=17]

FACT_ID: sec03-R22 | anchor: A03
A noncertified driving history can be obtained through an online account; a certified history can be requested at a DDS center with identification or through the mail. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=17]

FACT_ID: sec03-R23 | anchor: A03
Collecting another person's driving history requires that licensee's authorization on form DDS-18 naming the recipient and identifying the licensee. The recipient must also present identification. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=17]

FACT_ID: sec03-R24 | anchor: A03
A mailed driving-history request may use DDS-18 or a letter specifying the requested history period, full name, license number, birth date and complete mailing address, together with the required payment. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=17]

Misconceptions: A passing road-test percentage is not the same measure as the separate correct-answer threshold for either knowledge component.
Mnemonic: Prepare, demonstrate, review, then repeat only after the required wait.
Glossary: A certified driving history is the official record form offered through the stated in-person or mail route; an online downloaded copy is described separately.
Dynamic-fact isolation: Appointments, remote-testing arrangements, service eligibility, fees, document lists and administrative deadlines retain dated-source review.

corpus_stability.reason: Revision frequency and legal-currentness are not independently established; retain release hold while authoring the dated source-grounded candidate.

verification_debt.claim_text: The dated handbook facts retain source freshness, rights and independent factual-review debt; no current-law equivalence or live service/fee policy is certified.
Motorcycle, commercial and large noncommercial specialty-class testing is outside this regular Class C path.
Service-center hours and the source's claim about busiest visiting times are not verified current service availability.
Replacement price conflicts with earlier handbook prose; all replacement and driving-history fee amounts are withheld pending issuer reconciliation.

Voter registration, selective-service reporting, charitable donations and organ-donation medical statements are outside this driving-credential learning scope and are not authored as current legal or medical guidance.
Mailing destinations, phone numbers and exhaustive online-service availability were not verified as current; learners must use the issuer's current service instructions.
